articles.headline: AC Milan condemn racist abuse of Mike Maignan after red card vs. Bournemouth
articles.description: AC Milan have condemned what they called "serious and unacceptable racist abuse" directed at goalkeeper Mike Maignan on social media following his red card in Thursday's Europa League loss to Bournemouth.

articles.headline: 'If Mo Salah scores three...' - Hearts boss on puzzle to mark Trabzonspor star
articles.description: Wouter Vrancken hailed auxiliary left-back Rogers Mato for the way he stepped into the breach against Mohamed Salah as injury-hit Hearts produced a spirited display in a 2-0 Conference League defeat away to Trabzonspor.

articles.headline: Rose urges humility after Bournemouth rout Milan as Amorim rues red card
articles.description: Marco Rose said his Bournemouth team will stay humble after they dominated AC Milan 3-0 in the Europa League while Ruben Amorim said the match was over as a contest for his team after Mike Maignan's red card in the first half.

article.headline: Rangers see off Union 2-1 to secure top-eight slot
article.description: Nico Raskin headed the opener and Vaclav Cerny slotted a second as Rangers beat Belgian side Union Saint-Gilloise 2-1 in Glasgow on Thursday to go directly through to the Europa League round of 16.
article.linkText: Rangers see off Union 2-1 to secure top-eight slot
article.story:
Nico Raskin headed the opener and Vaclav Cerny slotted a second as Rangers beat Belgian side Union Saint-Gilloise 2-1 in Glasgow on Thursday to go directly through to the Europa League round of 16.

Belgian midfielder Raskin headed his first goal of the season in the 20th minute at Ibrox and Cerny calmly doubled the tally in the 55th as Rangers moved up from 13th to eighth in the table.

The visitors, who pulled a goal back through Kevin Mac Allister in the 83rd and had a Franjo Ivanovic equaliser ruled out for offside after a VAR check, progressed to the playoffs.

Rangers could have been 2-0 up just before halftime when Cyriel Dessers had the ball in the back of the net but the effort was ruled out for offside.
